description: Postgres via postgres-js and Drizzle, always through a pooled endpoint. The client refuses to boot on a connection string shaped like a direct one, because from Vercel that failure only shows up under load — see docs/postgres-pooling.md.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.note: The POOLED endpoint, over TLS. PgDog listens on 6432. Never point this at a database's own port from Vercel — every function instance opens its own connection and the server runs out. Local development and CI use a loopback host, where the rule does not apply.
